Our distribution philosophy
Why we don't
distill our own

"Great distribution is a craft of its own."

The traditional infused-liquor market is chaotic — hundreds of makers, no one controlling output quality. Buyers don't know who to trust.

Viet Distillery doesn't compete with Northwest artisans. We do what they can't: standardize, test and bring products to market with consistent reliability.

  • 🔬
    Vetted with food-science expertise Our founder holds a food-chemistry engineering degree. Every batch is checked for consistency before we take it on.
  • 📍
    Straight from the Northwest source Sơn La, Lai Châu, Mộc Châu — we know each region and each harvest season of the ingredients.
  • 🤝
    No middlemen From the artisan to our warehouse — no extra layers. Better prices, clearer provenance.

Where it comes from
From the Northwest
to your table
Núi Mường · Lào Cai
Northwest highlands — traditional villages
Local artisans → Viet Distillery warehouse → You

We do the searching
so you don't have to guess.

The Northwest is home to hundreds of traditional liquor households. Most have never sold beyond their village. We go there in person, meet them directly, taste every batch — and choose only those truly serious about their craft.

We don't take every batch. Not every season's ingredients make the cut. That's why every bottle bearing the Viet Distillery logo is one you can trust.
